text: Vanity of vanities... all is vanity
blank: 'Vanity of vanities,' says the Preacher; 'Vanity of vanities, all is ___.'
usage: 現代英語廣泛引用 vanity of vanities 或 all is vanity 感嘆世事虛無、追求終歸徒勞

text: no new thing under the sun
blank: there is no new thing under the ___
gloss: 日光之下無新事，一切都曾發生過
usage: 現代英語極常用 nothing new under the sun 表示某事並非首創、歷史總是重演

blank: all is vanity and a ___ after wind
gloss: 徒勞無功，捕風捉影般的追求
usage: 現代英語仍用 chasing after the wind 比喻追求虛幻、注定徒勞的目標

blank: for everything there is a season, and a ___ for every purpose under heaven
gloss: 凡事都有定時、都有合宜的時機
usage: 現代英語常引用 a time for everything 強調凡事皆有合適的時機，這段經文也是知名歌曲 Turn! Turn! Turn! 的歌詞來源

text: a time to be born, and a time to die
blank: a time to be born, and a time to ___
usage: 現代英語常引用 a time to be born and a time to die 表達生死自有其時、順其自然的態度

text: a time for war, and a time for peace
blank: a time for war, and a time for ___
usage: 現代英語（尤其政治評論）常引用 a time for war and a time for peace 討論衝突與和解的時機

blank: ___ are better than one, because they have a good reward for their labor
gloss: 兩人同心勝過孤軍奮戰，團結力量大
usage: 現代英語常用 two are better than one 強調合作、團隊勝過單打獨鬥

text: a threefold cord is not quickly broken
blank: a threefold cord is not quickly ___
gloss: 三股合成的繩子不易折斷，喻團結力量堅韌
usage: 現代英語（尤其婚禮致辭）常引用 a cord of three strands is not easily broken 象徵團結或婚姻中三方（含信仰）的堅韌

text: naked shall he go again as he came
blank: naked shall he go again as he ___
gloss: 赤裸而來，赤裸而去，喻生不帶來死不帶去
usage: 現代英語仍引用 naked I came, naked I shall return 一類說法，提醒財富終究帶不走

text: a good name is better than fine perfume
blank: a good name is better than fine ___
gloss: 良好的名聲勝過昂貴的香氣，喻名譽重於財富
usage: 現代英語常用 a good name is better than riches/perfume 一類說法強調名譽的珍貴

text: better is the end of a thing than its beginning
blank: better is the end of a thing than its ___
gloss: 結局勝過開端，強調堅持到底的價值
usage: 現代英語偶爾引用 the end of a thing is better than its beginning 鼓勵人重視最終成果、堅持到底

text: a living dog is better than a dead lion
blank: a living dog is better than a dead ___
gloss: 活著的小人物勝過死去的偉人，喻活著就有希望
usage: 現代英語仍偶爾引用 a living dog is better than a dead lion 強調活著、平凡也勝過顯赫卻已逝去

text: the race is not to the swift, nor the battle to the strong
blank: the race is not to the swift, nor the battle to the ___
gloss: 比賽未必屬於快者，戰爭未必屬於強者，勝負難料
usage: 現代英語（尤其體育、勵志語境）極常引用 the race is not to the swift 提醒實力並非決定成敗的唯一因素

text: dead flies cause the oil of the perfumer to produce an evil odor
blank: dead flies cause the oil of the perfumer to produce an evil ___
gloss: 一粒老鼠屎壞了一鍋粥，喻小瑕疵毀了整體
usage: 現代英語常用 a fly in the ointment（源自本節的另一種古老譯法）比喻美中不足、破壞整體的小缺點

text: he who digs a pit may fall into it
blank: he who digs a pit may fall into ___
gloss: 挖坑給別人的人，自己也可能掉進去，喻害人終害己
usage: 現代英語常引用 he who digs a pit shall fall into it 警告算計他人者最終可能自食惡果

text: money is the answer for all things
blank: money is the answer for all ___
gloss: 金錢萬能，凡事都能用錢解決
usage: 現代英語仍偶爾引用 money answers everything／all things 諷刺或感嘆金錢在現實生活中的萬能性

text: cast your bread on the waters
blank: cast your bread on the ___; for you shall find it after many days
gloss: 施恩不求回報，善舉終有回報
usage: 現代英語常用 cast your bread upon the waters 比喻慷慨行善或投資，即使當下看不到回報，日後終將有所收穫

gloss: 銀鏈斷裂，喻生命的終結
usage: 現代英語（尤其文學、靈性語境）仍用 the silver cord is severed／loosed 象徵死亡或生命與靈魂的分離

text: of making many books there is no end
blank: of making many books there is no ___
gloss: 著書立說沒有止境，讀書學問無窮無盡
usage: 現代英語（尤其學術圈）常幽默引用 of making many books there is no end 感嘆出版著作、知識累積永無止境
